notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for RTIambassador::createRegion and its HLAreportServiceInvocation delivery through the standard MIM. The direct §11.5.1 Table 5 p.299 r010 mapping remains limited to the successful RegionHandle HLAreturnedArgument. The scenario creates a valid region and checks the dimension-set argument, returned region designator, success and empty-exception fields, serial zero, region service type 5, reliable delivery, and inherited HLAfederate reporter identity. It then supplies a set containing a default-invalid DimensionHandle, verifies the API-declared InvalidDimensionHandle exception, and checks the failure MOM report's supplied dimension-set array, exception name, serial progression, and reporter identity. The supplemental failure assertions do not add a direct Table 5 requirement mapping for that argument form. Reporting is disabled before region cleanup. The test makes no region-based routing assertion and does not establish complete Table 5 or clause coverage, Java-provider interoperability, or conformance. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and configured dimension, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration.
